title: Cart Warranty
officialText:
5 Year Comprehensive Warranty
COZEWARE warrants that all our products is free from defects in materials and workmanship. We offer warranties of up to 5 years against manufacturing defects. Learn More
Shipping & Delivery
Items ship immediately upon availability. Orders deliver in 3-5 business days on average. Learn More
Fast & Professional Customer Support
Your satisfaction is our priority. Our dedicated team will try our best to process quick, expert responses to all inquiries. Contact us anytime via Email, Livechat, or Phone call. We're here to help!
